biggest_catch: Geography: membership is available in most of Oregon and select bordering Washington counties only. Payout is slow: the $300 is deposited no later than the last day of the 5th calendar month after account opening.
catches: Open a new Value, Rewards, or Platinum personal checking account (new checking customers only).
Set up a recurring direct deposit of at least $500 per month within 60 days of account opening.
Receive at least 2 direct deposits within the first 4 months.
$300 bonus is deposited into your Basic Savings account no later than the last day of the 5th calendar month after account opening.
The bonus is paid into your Basic Savings account, not the checking account; a Basic Savings comes free with membership.
Geography filter: most of Oregon and select bordering Washington counties.
Bonus is taxable; consult the credit union's disclosures for any additional terms.
